name: Wirthwein Fountain Inn, LLC
old_description: As an expert for innovative molds, we have been fulfilling individual customer requests since 1949. With 20 companies in Europe, Asia and the USA we are close to our customers all over the world. about:
Wirthwein Fountain Inn, LLC operates in Fountain Inn, South Carolina. The facility was established in 2012 and operated as South Carolina Plastics, LLC until June 2020, when it became part of the Wirthwein Group, a family-owned business founded in 1949.

The site specializes in plastics technology, providing mold design and manufacturing, injection molding, assembly, and logistics services. It produces weight-reduced plastic solutions for narrow assembly spaces, complex geometries and surfaces, maximum-security components for rail fastening systems, dimensionally stable and temperature-resistant parts from advanced thermoplastics, and economic plastic components for white goods, stoves, and floor-care devices.

The company serves the mobility, rail infrastructure, new energy, home appliance, medical, and interior design industries. Customers include automotive manufacturers requiring IATF 16949 compliance, railway operators needing rail fastening components worldwide, and medical technology firms. The group’s global footprint spans 20 companies across Europe, Asia, and the United States.

Wirthwein emphasizes its family-owned independence as a source of dynamic decision-making and long-term customer partnerships. The group describes itself as a reliable, stable partner that cultivates lasting market relationships while delivering innovative mold solutions and global production strategies.
